name: Ricky Elkins
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
address: 1 St Heliers Street, The Wellbeing Wing
description: I aim to offer a space where people can slow down and begin to make sense of experiences that feel stuck, challenging, or difficult to hold alone. You may find yourself here in the midst of transition, loss, relational difficulty, or uncertainty - or simply when familiar ways of living or coping no longer feel sustainable, and life begins to feel less steady than before. In this work, we turn toward what is present with care and curiosity - the patterns, the parts, the places in you that formed long ago in response to life, relationships, and the broader environments you have moved through.

name: Sophie Lord
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: I’m a person centred, compassionate and empathic psychotherapist who works primarily with adults with Complex Trauma. I specialise in working with survivors of Domestic and Family Violence. I also work with people experiencing depression, anxiety and can hold space for you in your grief.

name: Moses Adepoju
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Dr Moses G Adepoju is a clinical social worker and a clinical counsellor, behaviovior support practitioner, a personal and executive coach, psychotherapist, and a professional supervisor. Dr Adepoju has a Bachelor of Social Work, Master of Counselling and PhD in Social Work, Graduate Diploma in Training and Development and Advanced Certified Personal and Executive Coach (ACPEC). Dr Adepoju is an accredited Social Worker (MAASW), ACSW, accredited AMHSW, registered clinical counsellor PACFA, ACA clinical counsellor, PACFA accredited supervisor, AASW accredited clinical supervisor, ACA clinical supervisor, FDR Practitioner.

name: Linda Hartley
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: I am a Melbourne-based Counsellor and Psychotherapist specialising in Relationship Satisfaction for Individuals and Couples. My treatment approach is predominantly person-centred, attachment trauma informed, and emotion focused; allowing me to help clients get in touch with their feelings, manage their emotional experiences, seek emotional connections with meaningful others, and express what they need in intimate relationships to feel safe, secure, and uniquely valued as they navigate processes of Finding Love, Keeping Love, and Losing Love. I am currently engaged in internationally accredited training in trauma informed emotion-focused therapy for individuals with the Australian Institute for Emotion-Focused Therapy (AIEFT).

name: Rain Ali
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Areas listed on PACFA profile: Trauma recovery.

name: Sally Nicholls
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Offering behaviour Change therapeutic programs; individual counselling; relationship counselling; existential psychotherapy

name: Julia Holda
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Integrative practitioner, drawing on knowledge from evidence-based modalities such as Positive Psychology and Solution-Focused approaches to help enhance well-being and influence individuals make positive changes in their lives. I integrate person-centred, existential, psychodynamic, solution-focused, gestalt and narrative modalities to work collaboratively with clients to determine the approach that best suits their needs. I offer professional and confidential counselling for individuals, families and couples experiencing low self-esteem, social and emotional issues, anxiety, depression, grief & loss, difficult life-transitions, relationship concerns, trauma, parenting issues, workplace stress, interpersonal communication and assertiveness.

name: Heidi Rickard
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: I offer a compassionate, holistic, and person-centred approach. I believe every person has inherent value and a meaningful story. I aim to create a safe, respectful, and supportive space where clients feel truly heard and understood.
